hook: Democrats now control both House and Senate
caption:
🗳️ Democrats won both the House and Senate; Mississippi's Senate race is still being counted.
🛢️ More tankers hit in Hormuz. Oil jumped 3.8% Thursday, so watch fuel prices.
📉 Nasdaq fell more than 5%. Tech funds may swing for a while.
✈️ Hoax bomb threats hit at least 20 European flights. Check your airline before flying.
🏛️ A judge paused Trump's 250-ft Washington arch for 14 days.

Which story surprised you most?

1/5 Democrats win both chambers (250+)
Democrats won the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterms. It would be their largest House majority since 2008.

2/5 More tankers hit in Hormuz (+3.8%)
Iran says more tankers hit mines in Hormuz. Brent oil rose 3.8% Thursday, then eased early Friday.
📷 Frans Berkelaar (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Tech stocks tumble after vote (-5%)
The Nasdaq fell more than 5% on Thursday. Investors are reassessing AI data centre plans after the vote.
📷 BalticServers.com (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

4/5 Hoax bomb threats hit flights (20+)
At least 20 European flights got hoax bomb threats Thursday. Second wave this week; no bombs found, no one blamed.
